caseStudies.title: Commerce API Platform

Defined API contracts, synchronous and asynchronous flows, caching, and resiliency patterns.

versions.label: Master portfolio
versions.headline: Building systems that scale. Leading teams that deliver.
versions.summary: I’m Harendra, a software architect and technical leader with 16+ years across commerce, retail, healthcare, financial services, and media. I take complex problems from discovery to architecture, hands-on implementation, delivery, and production operations.

versions.label: Solution Architect
versions.headline: Turning complex requirements into resilient systems.
versions.summary: I design and deliver distributed platforms from business discovery through production. Across commerce, supply chain, and inventory domains, I define service boundaries, event-driven integrations, cloud deployment approaches, and the operational practices that keep systems reliable.

versions.label: Principal / Staff Engineer
versions.headline: Deep technical work, from design to production.
versions.summary: I stay close to the code while shaping platform architecture. My work spans Java and Spring Boot services, APIs, event streams, cloud infrastructure, resilience, observability, and modernization—with ownership through incidents and ongoing improvement.

versions.label: Engineering Manager
